translations.cfgdocs.ethernet.enabled.help: Enable or disable the W5500 Ethernet interface. When Ethernet is active, it has priority; WiFi station and then AP provisioning are used as fallback if Ethernet does not get an IP.
translations.cfgdocs.ethernet.enabled.label: Ethernet enabled
translations.cfgdocs.ethernet.dhcp.label: Automatic configuration (DHCP)
translations.cfgdocs.ethernet.dhcp.help: Enabled: network settings are supplied automatically by the router. Disabled: the static IPv4 settings below are used.
translations.cfgdocs.ethernet.ip.label: Ethernet IP address
translations.cfgdocs.ethernet.ip.help: Static IPv4 address of the Waveshare, used only when DHCP is disabled.
translations.cfgdocs.ethernet.subnet.label: Ethernet subnet mask
translations.cfgdocs.ethernet.subnet.help: IPv4 subnet mask associated with the static address, for example 255.255.255.0.
translations.cfgdocs.ethernet.gateway.label: Ethernet gateway
translations.cfgdocs.ethernet.gateway.help: IPv4 address of the router used as gateway.
translations.cfgdocs.ethernet.dns1.label: Primary Ethernet DNS
translations.cfgdocs.ethernet.dns1.help: Primary DNS server. When empty, the gateway is used.
translations.cfgdocs.ethernet.dns2.label: Secondary Ethernet DNS
